root_cause: The existing read-only hourly Janitor scanned GitHub GET /actions/runs status=completed which projects the most recent attempt for each workflow run; after GitHub Required run 44061313845 attempt 1 failed and attempt 2 succeeded, only the latest success is visible in this listing. GitHub separately preserves GET /actions/runs/44061313845/attempts/1 with conclusion=failure and original head SHA. An hourly scan can therefore miss the initial error after a fast rerun; earlier durable-window repair alone cannot correct that.
prevention: Within original same hourly Janitor, when source workflow run's run_attempt > 1, read separately each older native attempt by exact run_id and attempt index, verify workflow_id/head_sha/event/attempt/status all match native parent identity, classify as NATIVE_FAILURE only for genuine failed original attempt.

Reuse the exact existing classifyActionsRun native payloadSHA256 / brain_observe_failure + original read-after-write, so manually backfilled run/attempt with matching provider identity remains deduplicated and hash conflicts fail closed.

Limit historic attempts per run <=51 and prior-attempt source reads <=100 per complete four-hour source window. Overflow or missing native history never produces global green, and previous verified windows remain durable even when later reads fail.
Do not change the sole existing Janitor cron, provider sender, source registry, access controls or branch protection; original recovery supervisor retains native CAS and short terminal leases.
acceptance: Original exact-head Required/CodeQL PASS, protected main merge, next natural original hourly Janitor scan, original ONE BRAIN confirmed native failed attempt occurrence with exact provider evidence SHA and later identical rerun ALREADY_VERIFIED. Any unmet stage remains OPEN; not proof that all historical errors have been recovered.
validation_limits: This covers native attempt history on the 48-hour bounded repository-run scan. Older errors outside bounded source retention require separately authorized owner replay. Max provider-read budget may fail closed; this is a safe source coverage alarm, not silent completion.
